metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Las Vegas, Nevada exceed 130 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use GRIDMET daily maximum 2-m air temperature (IDAHO_EPSCOR/GRIDMET, band tmmx in Kelvin) for Las Vegas point buffered by 10 km, dates 2017-06-15 to 2017-06-21 (end exclusive 2017-06-22). If empty, fallback to ERA5-Land Hourly (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) aggregated to daily max.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (reanalysis/gridded product). Validate with non-masked pixel counts via Reducer.count().
3. Logic: Compute daily regional max in °F, check counts > 0. If collections empty -> C1; if counts all 0 -> C2; if any null/NaN or implausible (< -100F or > 150F) -> C3; else determine if any day exceeded 130°F -> A else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-115.1398, 36.1699]); // Las Vegas, NV
    const region = pt.buffer(10000); // 10 km buffer
    const start = ee.Date('2017-06-15');
    const end = ee.Date('2017-06-22'); // end-exclusive to include 21st

    // Helper to convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit
    const kToF = (k) => (k - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (primary: GRIDMET tmmx)
    let usedDataset = 'GRIDMET';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('IDAHO_EPSCOR/GRIDMET')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(region)
      .select(['tmmx'], ['v']);

    let size = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (size === 0) {
      console.log('GRIDMET Images: 0');
      // Fallback: ERA5-Land Hourly -> daily max
      usedDataset = 'ERA5-LAND';
      let era = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .select(['temperature_2m'], ['v']);
      let eraSize = await era.size().getInfo();
      if (!eraSize || eraSize === 0) {
        console.log('ERA5-LAND Images: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      // Build daily max FeatureCollection
      const nDays = ee.Number(end.difference(start, 'day')).int();
      const days = ee.List.sequence(0, nDays.subtract(1));
      const dailyFC = ee.FeatureCollection(days.map(function(d) {
        d = ee.Number(d);
        const ds = start.advance(d, 'day');
        const de = ds.advance(1, 'day');
        const dayImg = era.filterDate(ds, de).max().rename('v');
        const dict = dayImg.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 5000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        });
        return ee.Feature(null, dict.set('date', ds.format('YYYY-MM-dd')));
      }));
      const info = await dailyFC.getInfo();
      await processAndAnswer(info, usedDataset);
    } else {
      console.log(`GRIDMET Images: ${size}`);
      // 3. Processing for GRIDMET
      const dailyFC = ee.FeatureCollection(col.map(function(img) {
        const dict = img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 4000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        });
        const date = ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd');
        return ee.Feature(null, dict.set('date', date));
      })).sort('date');
      const info = await dailyFC.getInfo();
      await processAndAnswer(info, usedDataset);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function processAndAnswer(info, usedDataset) {
  try {
    const features = (info && info.features) ? info.features : [];
    console.log(`Dataset: ${usedDataset}`);
    if (features.length === 0) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    let anyValidPixels = false;
    let exceeded = false;
    let overallMaxF = -Infinity;
    let calcFailure = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < features.length; i++) {
      const props = features[i].properties || {};
      const date = props.date || 'NA';
      const vMax = props['v_max'];
      const vCount = props['v_count'];
      const count = (typeof vCount === 'number') ? Math.round(vCount) : 0;

      let line = `${date} MaxF: `;
      if (vMax === null || vMax === undefined || isNaN(vMax)) {
        line += 'null';
        console.log(`${line}, Pixels: ${count}`);
        continue;
      }
      const f = (vMax - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32;
      if (isNaN(f) || f < -100 || f > 150) {
        calcFailure = true;
      }
      if (count > 0) anyValidPixels = true;
      if (f > overallMaxF) overallMaxF = f;
      if (f > 130) exceeded = true;

      line += `${f.toFixed(1)}, Pixels: ${count}`;
      console.log(line);
    }

    if (!anyValidPixels) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (!isFinite(overallMaxF)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Overall MaxF: ${overallMaxF.toFixed(1)}`);

    if (calcFailure) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (exceeded) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Processing error:', e && e.message ? e.message : e);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
